Stop! It's hazardous area beyond here.\nIt's off-limits.
...What? King Elbano and Pino the goddess of\nSofya asked you to investigate? I-I am so sorry!!\nPlease watch your step.
Look! It's well-concealed but there's a cave!\nLet's get inside.
Oops... I also like treasures but I can't leave\nMochelo alone...
Meh. I and Mochelo will watch out for suspicious\npeople coming. So, give us some share of the\ntreasures, okay?
Welcome back! How was it?\nHave you got some treasures...?
No time for that! Ruuuuun!!
Hey, it's you guys. What happened?\nYou're covered with dust and worn out...\nWhat? Lyark has a huge crysta factory?
So, you blew it up?\nI see, that's why you look so.\nWhat were they going to do with such a thing...
Well, it's okay.\nBy the way, York is missing.\nDid you see him?
He looked depressed since then.\nSo, I'm worried about him.
Tell them what has happened.
Don't tell them what has happened.
You tried to tell what has happened in the huge\ncrysta factory but...
Hey!!
You couldn't tell Yarn and Mondan that York\nbetrayed them...
What's wrong?
Where's York now.\nWhat if he can't move because of ill or something...
He should be alright. He's not a kid.\nHe'll be back when he gets hungry!
That sounds like a kid, you know?
I'm sorry for bothering you.\nIf you see him, tell him to come back to see us.\nThanks in advance.
Perhaps, he was depressed because you made fun of\nhim too much because he's not good at magic?
What are you saying?! I highly appreciate his\nengineering skills. I gave him a pep talk so he\ncan get better at using magic...
Will there be a chance for them to convey their\nfeelings to York...?
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing!
